en: Kind of another word for AI agents is the
word harness. And you can really use terms
interchangeably here. I told you that an AI
agent is a piece of software like the
ChatGPT application or the Claude
application.
Now, those types of applications are also
sometimes called agent harnesses because the
idea is that the agent harness is the thing,
the piece of software that is wrapped around
a large language model as a brain, which
then is responsible for gathering all the
relevant information, all the relevant
context that model needs to
conclude its work or to do its work. So it's
the harness that's responsible for sending
information about the tools and for
executing the tool calls, but that's also
responsible for, for example, finding
relevant memory and sending that memory to
the model or for storing memory. So you
could say the terms harness and AI agent are
kind of the same thing. But the term AI
agent tends to describe the overall system,
whereas the harness really is the concrete
piece of software that is responsible for
managing the relevant context, for
performing the tool calls, and so on. So the
harness is the concrete implementation of
the AI agent idea, you could say.
